channel.title: AIBuilder Marketplace — new honest reviews
channel.description: Hand-researched, honest software reviews: real pricing, the honest knock, who should skip it. No hype, no invented numbers.

item.title: Finmo Review (2026): $0 Business Account, 0.07% Intro FX
item.description: Finmo: $0 to open, $0 a month, no minimum balance and unlimited user seats at no charge. The low FX rate is an introductory offer with strings.

item.title: KillerPlayer Review (2026): YouTube Player, Free or From $2/mo
item.description: KillerPlayer: A free plan covers 5 videos and 500 views a month and is described as not a trial. If a subscription lapses, embedded videos stop playing.

item.title: Parallels Desktop Review (2026): Windows on Mac, From €99.99/yr
item.description: Parallels Desktop runs Windows, Linux or macOS in a virtual machine on a Mac. Your Windows licence is a separate cost and is not included in any edition.

item.title: Tossable Digits Review (2026): Virtual Phone Numbers From $7/mo
item.description: Tossable Digits: Extra US or Canada numbers cost $3.49, $2.99, $2.19 or $1.49 a month and extra minutes $0.12, $0.10. Annual plans get no pro-rated refund.

item.title: Tradelle Review (2026): Dropshipping Research, From $19.99/mo
item.description: Tradelle: Lite is $29.99 a month, or $19.99 a month billed as $239.88 a year. The subscription is only the start of the bill.

item.title: Shortcut Chat Review (2026): Multi-Model AI Chat From $20/mo
item.description: Shortcut Chat: Pro is $20 a month or $216 a year, Pro+ is $40 a month or $432 a year. The usage allowance is the unknown.

item.title: AML Watcher Review (2026): AML Screening, Setup From $250
item.description: AML Watcher sells anti-money-laundering screening in three plans. The recurring price is only visible after you set the search volume in the calculator.

item.title: Upwork Review (2026): Freelance Hiring Fees Explained
item.description: Upwork is a marketplace where clients hire freelancers. The Client Marketplace Fee is not refundable even if the payment is refunded.

item.title: HighLevel Review (2026): Agency CRM & Automation From $97/mo
item.description: HighLevel: Starter costs $97 a month ($970 a year) and is meant for one business or a few clients. The headline plan price is only part of the bill.

item.title: Mystrika Review (2026): Cold Email, Free Plan, From $16/mo
item.description: Mystrika: Free Forever costs $0, needs no card and gives 500 prospect slots, up to 50 senders.

item.title: B12 Review (2026): AI Website Builder From $24/mo
item.description: B12: Free costs $0 a month, publishes on a b12sites.com subdomain and gives 5 daily AI credits with a maximum of 30 a month.

item.title: Future Skills Academy Review (2026): AI Courses From $25/mo
item.description: Future Skills Academy sells three plans. Dollar signs are shown without a currency code, and the headline prices sit next to crossed-out higher prices.

item.title: SupportYourApp Review (2026): Outsourced Support From $1,200/mo
item.description: SupportYourApp does not publish prices. No prices are published, only a starting point given in a partner message and described as under review.

item.title: SendHQ Review (Tested): Email API for Developers From $9/mo
item.description: SendHQ: $97.20 a year for Starter Transactional, $205.20 for Starter Marketing and $421.20 for Scale. The monthly allowance is a hard cap.

item.title: RankBolt Review (2026): AI SEO Articles and Rank Tracking
item.description: RankBolt prices in Swiss francs and sells three monthly plans, each with a 3-day free trial that, per the page, needs no credit card.

item.title: SocialDesk Review (2026): AI Social Scheduler, From $19/mo
item.description: SocialDesk sells four monthly plans and every one starts with a 7-day free trial that, per the page, needs no credit card. Pinterest is not supported yet.

item.title: DataHawk Review (2026): Amazon Analytics, Custom Pricing
item.description: DataHawk: The terms describe monthly and annual subscriptions, a free version and a 14-day free trial.

item.title: Elite Site Optimizer Review (2026): SEO Tools From $49/mo
item.description: Elite Site Optimizer: Basic costs $49 a month ($470 a year) for 1 domain, 1 user, 1 campaign, 100 keywords, 1,000 crawl pages and 3 competitors.

item.title: WPForms Review (2026): WordPress Forms From $49.50/Year
item.description: WPForms: $49.50 a year for one site (Basic), $99.50 for three (Plus), $199.50 for five (Pro) and $299.50 for unlimited sites (Elite).

item.title: AI for Database Review (2026): Plain-English Queries, $10/user
item.description: AI for Database: Pro costs $10 per user per month and adds $10 of credits per payment. The homepage says "Free plan available - No credit card required".

item.title: SeedProd Review (2026): WordPress Builder, Renewals at Full Price
item.description: SeedProd is a WordPress plugin sold as a yearly licence. The prices on the pricing page are first-year discounts; renewals are at full price.

item.title: EazyChat Review (2026): AI Website Chat From $29.99 per User
item.description: EazyChat charges per user per month. Pricing is per user, so a team of five pays five times the plan price.

item.title: Vynaris Review (2026): LLM Router, Provider Price Plus 3%
item.description: Vynaris is an API gateway, so what you pay is mostly the price of the models it calls for you. The routing fee comes on top of the model price.

item.title: Pixasocial Review (2026): AI Social Content and Posting Suite
item.description: Pixasocial sells one suite in four sizes. The pricing is in flux: the plans, names and amounts had changed between our reads in October and November 2026.

item.title: UPDF Review (2026): PDF Editor, Lifetime or Yearly With AI
item.description: UPDF: US$0 for the AI part today, then it renews at US$69 a year unless you cancel. The free version puts a trial watermark on edited files.

item.title: MK Website Assistant Review (2026): AI Enquiry Bot From £39/mo
item.description: MK Website Assistant: AI Assistant Plus also costs from £290 and then £59 a month. Prices are "from" amounts, so the final set-up fee can be higher.

item.title: VideoUpload Review (2026): YouTube Team Board From $20/mo
item.description: VideoUpload charges one flat price per workspace, with no per-seat fees. AI writing uses credits that reset monthly; extra credits are a paid top-up.

item.title: Orateur Review (2026): AI Phone Receptionist From CHF 49/mo
item.description: Orateur prices by plan, each with an allowance of AI agent time. The site is in French only and prices are in Swiss francs.

item.title: Ploy Review (2026): AI Website Builder, Free to $300/mo
item.description: Ploy: The Free tier costs $0, needs no card and includes 2,000 credits (the plan card says 500 credits a day, up to 2,000).

item.title: PrintSage Review (2026): US Print on Demand, No Subscription
item.description: PrintSage has no subscription and no plan price. Production and shipping are US-only: six US fulfillment centers, no overseas production.
